import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from syntax import parse_policy
from compiler.compiler import compile_policy
def show(pol, names):
    rules, a, p = parse_policy(pol)
    order = sorted(names)
    idx = {n:i for i,n in enumerate(order)}
    acc, rows, cells = compile_policy(rules, order, idx)
    print(repr(pol), order, 'cells',cells)
    print('   accept', acc)
    for r in rows: print('   ', ['DENY' if x==4294967295 else x for x in r])

    ('match(A) allow;', ['A','B']),
    ('contains(A) allow; match(A,B) drop;', ['A','B']),
    ('(match(A) and match(B)) allow;', ['A','B']),
    ('not(match(A)) allow;', ['A','B']),
    ('(match(A) or match(B)) allow;', ['A','B']),
    ('endswith(A,B) allow;', ['A','B']),
    ('match(A) allow; match(A) drop;', ['A','B']),
    ('startswith(A) allow; contains(B) drop;', ['A','B']),
